title: Cavalry into the Deccan
historical_background: In the 1720s and 1730s the Peshwa Baji Rao I directed rapid cavalry campaigns across the Deccan, clashing and bargaining with the Nizam and other regional powers. This scenario is a gameplay abstraction of that expansion pressure, not a reconstruction of any single battle such as Palkhed (1728).
historical_outcome: Maratha cavalry pressure extracted chauth and shaped Deccan politics through a mix of battle, raid, and negotiation. Exact sequences and numbers remain debated.
victory: Control at least 7 territories including Ahmednagar, or capture Hyderabad.
defeat: Lose Pune, or lose all armies, or survive 14 turns without meeting victory.
